classification_legend.COVERED: Repository has an explicit governed capability with a plausible executable/evaluation path; research mainly reinforces it.
classification_legend.PARTIAL: Substantial authority exists but research exposes a missing state model, robustness check, integration layer, or long-form execution boundary.
classification_legend.MISSING: The required first-class capability is not materially implemented in the reviewed branch artifacts.
classification_legend.UNSUPPORTED: Capability should intentionally not be automated or claimed under current rights/safety/authority boundaries.
classification_legend.HUMAN_ONLY: Valid capability requires direct author/editor/reader judgment or evidence that unattended automation cannot create.

system_conclusion.summary: The Literary Prose Engine already has unusually broad line-level craft coverage, preservation-first revision governance, independent comparison, reader-experience dimensions and anti-homogenization controls. The highest-value remaining gaps are not another generic writing rubric. They are: finding-to-opportunity admission; canonical story/discourse time plus entity-event-causal state; global narrative orchestration/anchor modeling; durable character/arc state and invalidation; and evaluator robustness against creative-judgment failure modes.
do_not_do: Do not add a universal prose or creativity score.
Do not substitute named-author similarity for project voice.
Do not treat stylistic attractiveness as superior to story function.
Do not force a winner when literary evidence is conflicted or human preferences genuinely diverge.
Do not use aggregate chapter statistics as a substitute for event/causal/temporal narrative state.

capabilities.gap: The system can reason about structure and whole-book signals, but it lacks a canonical manuscript truth graph and global narrative-function anchor model capable of supporting robust developmental changes across chapters.
capabilities.research_implication: Professional structural editing requires organization/content reasoning conditioned on audience, medium and purpose; 2026 LitVISTA shows frontier models still fail at integrated narrative orchestration.
capabilities.next_action: Build canonical narrative-state/orchestration authority before expanding broad developmental rewrite power.

capabilities.gap: No major taxonomy gap found; the main missing integration was opportunity admission between calibrated findings and revision generation.
capabilities.research_implication: Editors Canada reinforces minimal necessary change, sentence/paragraph coherence, and preservation of voice/POV/tone/register.
capabilities.next_action: Close STEP-008 admission rather than adding more generic line-edit dimensions.

capabilities.gap: Current reviewed artifacts do not expose a durable first-class distinction among story time, discourse time and narrating time, nor a fully explicit narrator-versus-focalizer relation across multiple perspectival parameters.
capabilities.research_implication: Living Handbook narratology separates narrator voice from perspective/focalization and distinguishes story/discourse/narrating time.
capabilities.next_action: Create narratology state objects that represent temporal and perspectival relations rather than only detecting local features.

capabilities.gap: The engine does not yet bind NLP-derived entities, events, causal relations, temporal relations and discourse functions into one canonical manuscript state layer.
capabilities.research_implication: 2025-2026 long-story research repeatedly benefits from entity/event/temporal graph representations and explicit anchor localization.
capabilities.next_action: Introduce a provenance-bearing narrative state graph with source-span anchors and confidence/abstention.

capabilities.gap: Reader-state dimensions exist, but durable discourse-relation/event-link evidence is not yet a canonical dependency for revision opportunity generation.
capabilities.research_implication: Long-form coherence systems and 2026 narrative-orchestration research show that explicit structural anchors improve diagnosis beyond local fluency.
capabilities.next_action: Bind coherence findings to canonical event/discourse anchors and invalidate downstream claims when anchors change.

capabilities.gap: The preservation gate exists, but a durable epistemic-privilege model that distinguishes narrator, focalizer, perception, knowledge, language and ideology is not explicit in reviewed runtime artifacts.
capabilities.research_implication: Narratology treats perspective as multidimensional and relational, not merely first/third person or camera distance.
capabilities.next_action: Add perspectival-state fixtures for narrator/focalizer separation, knowledge access, viewpoint shifts and intentional violations.

capabilities.gap: No major missing category found; future hardening should test controlled distance shifts across chapter spans.
capabilities.research_implication: Narratology supports treating distance/perspective as variable rather than enforcing one fixed mode.
capabilities.next_action: Add long-span regressions when canonical perspective state is introduced.

repository_evidence: AGLO chapter models and five arc bands
capabilities.gap: Aggregate arc bands and chapter metrics do not yet encode event function, setup/payoff dependencies, anchor localization, or causal/temporal validity across the whole book.
capabilities.research_implication: LitVISTA reports systematic failure to jointly capture narrative function and structure; the 2025 Novel benchmark supports macro/meso/micro evaluation.
capabilities.next_action: Represent scene/chapter/book event anchors and function/dependency links in the narrative state graph.

capabilities.gap: The dimensions are strong; temporal duration/frequency/order authority remains a dependency for truly narratological pacing rather than surface rate metrics.
capabilities.research_implication: Narrative time theory distinguishes story/discourse duration, and surprise research requires retrospective coherence rather than raw unpredictability.
capabilities.next_action: Bind existing pacing signals to the future story/discourse-time model.

capabilities.gap: No categorical gap found; pragmatic competence of automated evaluators remains a robustness concern.
capabilities.research_implication: 2026 pragmatic-judge research shows generation and pragmatic judgment can be weakly aligned, so dialogue evaluation should remain evidence-based and independently checked.
capabilities.next_action: Add pragmatic/subtext adversarial evaluator fixtures rather than another dialogue generator.

capabilities.gap: Mention distributions and local character diagnostics are not a durable multidimensional psychological/goal/belief/relationship state model across book time.
capabilities.research_implication: 2026 PersonaForge and long-form consistency research reinforce persistent multidimensional state to reduce character drift.
capabilities.next_action: Create durable character-state objects layered on the canonical event/time graph; keep personality models descriptive, not prescriptive.

capabilities.gap: No first-order gap; global anti-homogenization should compare distributions rather than reward one cadence target.
capabilities.research_implication: 2025/2026 style-homogenization evidence supports distributional preservation over generic fluency optimization.
capabilities.next_action: Extend defense metrics to baseline-relative multi-span cadence drift if not already materialized.

capabilities.gap: No categorical gap found; ensure syntactic complexity is not treated as a monotonic quality objective.
capabilities.research_implication: Human/machine profiling research finds domain-dependent variation; one complexity target would homogenize prose.
capabilities.next_action: Retain range-based/project-relative diagnostics.

capabilities.gap: Detection exists conceptually, but robust metaphor interpretation/function evidence is not clearly separated from surface anomaly/novelty signals.
capabilities.research_implication: ACL 2025 research shows LLM metaphor performance may ride on lexical overlap and sentence length rather than deep figurative understanding.
capabilities.next_action: Add metaphor-function fixtures where identical surface novelty has different contextual purpose and preservation standing.

capabilities.gap: No categorical gap; whole-book event/time state will improve causal/temporal information-release checks.
capabilities.research_implication: Professional editing and discourse research support coherence and audience-relative clarity rather than maximizing explicitness.
capabilities.next_action: Preserve ambiguity when intentional; bind later to event/knowledge state.

capabilities.gap: Motif signals exist, but durable motif lifecycle objects with introduction, recurrence, transformation, payoff and invalidation are not explicit.
capabilities.research_implication: Global narrative orchestration requires function across separated anchors, not only frequency or local repetition detection.
capabilities.next_action: Represent motif anchors/roles as a layer on global orchestration state.

capabilities.gap: Emerging 2026 evidence suggests adding explicit identity-marker/distribution drift tests across repeated AI revisions.
capabilities.research_implication: Nature Human Behaviour 2026 reports linguistic diversity compression and shifts in inferred personal traits under AI assistance.
capabilities.next_action: Harden with multi-revision identity/diversity drift fixtures; do not target named-author similarity.

capabilities.gap: At the reviewed baseline, there is no executable bridge that deduplicates calibrated findings, preserves disagreement, gates risk/scope, and admits a bounded opportunity set before revision generation.
capabilities.research_implication: 2026 Style-over-Story and 2025 no-consensus/judge-instability evidence make this a critical control: surface-attractive or repeated correlated findings must not vote themselves into revision.
capabilities.next_action: Implement BOOK-INTELLIGENCE-UNIFICATION-001-STEP-008 opportunity admission now.

capabilities.gap: Conceptual abstention is strong, but evaluator robustness does not yet explicitly test uncertainty-marker bias, repeated-run judge instability and no-consensus preservation together.
capabilities.research_implication: 2025-2026 judge studies show inconsistency, forced stances and bias against epistemic markers.
capabilities.next_action: Add an evaluator reliability harness after STEP-008.

capabilities.gap: The core authority split exists; stage-specific editor roles and query/escalation reasons could be more explicitly represented in review packets.
capabilities.research_implication: Professional standards emphasize defined scope, querying unresolved matters, checking introduced regressions and not drifting between edit stages without authorization.
capabilities.next_action: Add edit-stage/scope/query metadata to future review packet schema, without blocking STEP-008.

capabilities.gap: The evaluator should add explicit intra-rater stability, self-preference separation, score-range resistance, uncertainty-marker robustness and prior-belief separation for subjective/rhetorical content.
capabilities.research_implication: LitBench, Rating Roulette, score-range bias, self-preference and prior-belief studies all show generic LLM judging is not stable authority for literary quality.
capabilities.next_action: Create EVALUATOR-ROBUSTNESS-002 packet with repeated/permuted/blinded fixtures and human-escalation thresholds.

capabilities.gap: No categorical gap; automated judgments should remain cautious where cultural or ideological norms are contested.
capabilities.research_implication: Professional standards condition edits on intended readers; 2026 judge research shows prior beliefs/cultural framing can contaminate quality judgments.
capabilities.next_action: Route belief/cultural-value disagreements to evidence or human review instead of treating conformity as quality.

capabilities.gap: Add explicit repeated-assistance drift and style-over-story regression fixtures to harden an already strong defense.
capabilities.research_implication: 2026 evidence directly validates risks of homogenization, routine-solution bias and model preference for style over story.
capabilities.next_action: Treat these as defense hardening, not a reason to redesign the system.

capabilities.gap: No reviewed artifact provides canonical story-time vs discourse-time vs narrating-time order/duration/frequency state with source anchors and contradiction handling.
capabilities.research_implication: Narratology and 2025-2026 long-story research independently converge on explicit temporal representation as central to coherence.
capabilities.next_action: Make this the highest-value new architectural packet after STEP-008.

capabilities.gap: The reviewed branch has no canonical provenance-bearing entity/event/causal manuscript graph that downstream specialists share as truth authority.
capabilities.research_implication: STORYTELLER, DOME, Lost in Stories and LitVISTA all reinforce explicit event/entity/temporal anchors for long-form coherence and evaluation.
capabilities.next_action: Build graph authority together with story/discourse time rather than separate incompatible models.

capabilities.gap: Current arc bands are aggregated measurement slices; they are not durable function-bearing arc objects with event anchors, dependency edges, setup/payoff lifecycle, invalidation and re-evaluation rules.
capabilities.research_implication: LitVISTA specifically identifies global narrative orchestration and anchor localization as frontier-model weaknesses.
capabilities.next_action: Add durable arc/motif/setup-payoff objects on top of canonical narrative state.

capabilities.gap: Automation cannot create real reader/editor/author judgments, disagreement distributions or consent.
capabilities.research_implication: Creative-writing benchmarks and professional literary evaluation continue to show meaningful human/automatic disagreement.
capabilities.next_action: Prepare protocols and evidence schemas only; never synthesize human evidence.
